# Rohith Singhu

> Rohith Singhu is a Software Developer at Viacore Technologies Inc. (since Sep 2026) who builds AI tools that connect answers to evidence: document retrieval (RAG), agent workflows, human-review gates and the software around them. Based in Cleveland, Ohio.

## About

- Current role: Software Developer, Viacore Technologies Inc. (Sep 2026 – present)
- Previous: Software Intern, Tech Mahindra (Jan 2024 – Jun 2024); Student IT Assistant, AUM Library
- Education: M.S. Computer Science, Auburn University at Montgomery (May 2026); B.Tech Computer Science (robotics specialization), VIT-AP University
- Certifications: CompTIA Security+ (Sep 2026); AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (May 2025)
- Research: co-author, "Physiotherapy assistance with human pose estimation", ASEAN Journal of Scientific and Technological Reports, 2024 (DOI: 10.55164/ajstr.v27i4.251096)
- Contact: rohithsinghu7@gmail.com · GitHub: https://github.com/rohith-jpg · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/rohithsinghu/

## Projects

- [RAGenius](https://rohith-jpg.github.io/projects/ragenius.html): Document Q&A for people who need to check the source. Retrieves PDF passages, attaches citations, and abstains when the evidence is missing. Stack: Python, FastAPI, FAISS, Sentence-Transformers, Streamlit. Result: 52/75 tasks passed in the committed evaluation; 10/10 should-abstain tasks passed.
- [VerticalDesk](https://rohith-jpg.github.io/projects/verticaldesk.html): An AI-assisted triage prototype for service teams: classifies a request, retrieves knowledge-base articles, drafts a cited resolution, and waits for human approval. Stack: React, FastAPI, Python, MongoDB, RAG. Result: README reports 34/34 automated tests passing; approval gate before incident creation.
- [Agent Orchestration](https://rohith-jpg.github.io/projects/agent-orchestration.html): A task orchestration prototype that routes research and code work to specialists, reviews outputs, and records decisions in a structured trace. Stack: Python, LangGraph, Anthropic API, Tavily, Docker. Result: Example trace records planning, dispatch, tools, review and synthesis.
- [RxSupply AI](https://rohith-jpg.github.io/projects/rxsupply-ai.html): An evidence-grounded medicine supply prototype for operations teams. Validates model-selected facts against FDA records and prepares simulated replenishment plans for human review. Stack: Python, SQLite FTS5, BM25, Ollama, JSON API. Result: 10/10 regression cases passed on the retrieval and validation path; 1,600 normalized records in the dated source snapshot.
- [JobLens MCP](https://rohith-jpg.github.io/projects/joblens-mcp.html): An MCP server for job seekers using AI assistants. Combines official job-search API results, local resume parsing and an explainable skill-overlap score. Stack: Python, FastMCP, Adzuna API, PDF parsing. Result: Search, parse and match exposed as assistant tools.
- [Lateral Movement Hunt](https://github.com/rohith-jpg/lateral-movement-hunt): A reproducible investigation exercise for analysts. Correlates authentication and execution records, then presents an evidence-linked timeline and alerts. Stack: Python, JSONL, Splunk SPL, MITRE ATT&CK, JavaScript. Result: 14 synthetic events produce 2 alerts in one scenario; includes benign controls and evidence prerequisites.
- [Workplace Systems Lab](https://github.com/rohith-jpg/workplace-systems-lab): An offline review tool for access, device inventories, SaaS seats and tickets. Produces prioritized findings and readable evidence for a systems reviewer. Stack: Python, CSV / JSON, HTML / CSS, GitHub Actions. Result: 13 findings across 6 fictional users and 6 assets; 4 automated tests pass in the local lab.
